sections.label: Electronic Gazette authoritative status Bill
sections.summary: The Bill aims to give the electronic Gazette authoritative status, as only the print Gazette is currently authoritative under the Interpretation Act 1965.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: From October to December 2024, the electronic Gazette website saw a monthly average of over 8,000 unique visitors, whereas the print Gazette only has 15 subscribers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: In this regard, I am pleased to share with Members that we rolled out a new electronic Gazette website last September, with significant improvements in useability, reliability, security and resilience.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Today, under section 48 of the Interpretation Act 1965, only the print Gazette is authoritative, in the sense that only the print Gazette is prima facie evidence of its contents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: This is not compatible with how the Gazette is published and used today.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Hence, the key objective of the Bill is to confer authoritative status on the electronic Gazette, as well as electronic versions of revised editions of legislation.

sections.label: Electronic Gazette evidence and precedence
sections.summary: Electronic Gazettes on the prescribed website will be prima facie evidence, prevail over other versions, and courts must take judicial notice of them.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: First, electronic Gazettes published on the prescribed website will be treated as prima facie evidence of the matters published within.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Second, to the extent of any inconsistency, the electronic Gazette will prevail over all other versions of the Gazette.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Third, the courts will be required to take judicial notice of the electronic Gazette, in addition to the print Gazette.

sections.label: Revised legislation electronic versions prevail
sections.summary: A new section 17A will let electronic versions of revised legislation prevail over print versions where inconsistent.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: A new section 17A will provide for electronic versions of revised legislation to prevail over print versions, to the extent of any inconsistency.
